name: io.github.DrMkdaddy/cat-burglar
title: Cat Burglar
description: Stealth browser MCP with three engines, proxy pools, remote CDP, diff observations, and benchmarks.

environmentVariables.name: BROWSER_MCP_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow localhost and private-network pages.

environmentVariables.name: BROWSER_MCP_OBSCURA_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the Obscura binary when it is not on PATH.

environmentVariables.name: BROWSER_MCP_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Observation profile: local, flash, frontier, or auto.

environmentVariables.name: BROWSER_MCP_PROXY_POOL
environmentVariables.description: JSON array or newline-separated HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5 proxy URLs.

environmentVariables.name: BROWSER_MCP_CDP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Remote Chrome DevTools Protocol endpoint for the remote engine.

environmentVariables.name: BROWSER_MCP_AUDIT
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to disable the local audit log.
